The system behind the screens

The screens

Flow: loading → login → home → shop → product → bag → checkout → confirmation, with account and chat one tap away from anywhere in the header.

Mobile · 390

The same brand, thumb-first

The Figma file only defines desktop, so every phone layout is an extension: two-up product grid, stacked summaries, a bottom tab bar and a sticky buy button.

Hand-off

What I'd add to the Figma file next

  • Seven more frames — home, shop filters, product on mobile, account, chat, login and the loading animation — so the file covers every screen in this deck.
  • A component sheet: buttons, inputs, pills, product card, order-status chip, tracker rail, toast.
  • Empty, loading and out-of-stock states for shop, bag and checkout.
  • Accessibility pass: focus rings, 4.5:1 contrast on the violet-on-white pairings, 44 px tap targets.
